summary: Take R = toAlgForm⁻¹ ∘ restrictToY: (1) holds by the definitions of ι and Bμ through the equivalence toAlgForm; (2) is the branching integral formula for algebraic-form coefficients along the block embedding, with the integral over the quotient identified with the class integral.

steps.claim: M = m (substitute), Y_M is standard (s) and its parameter is a Harish-Chandra parameter (w).

Choose R = toAlgForm⁻¹ ∘ restrictToY. (1) is the equivalence toAlgForm applied to both sides. (2): for t, the branching integral formula (integral_algFormCoeff_blockEmb with the branching data of D) gives a constant C' with ∫ coefficient·x̄ = C'·⟨x, restrictToY ψ⟩; take C = C'·#(…)·∏_τ(…), identify ∫ F·x̄ with the class integral of x̄ (integral_mul_eq_classIntegral) and compare the normalisations of restrictToY.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_ ∘ₗ D.restrictToY, (toAlgForm _ w).eq_symm_apply.1, fun t ↦
    (integral_algFormCoeff_blockEmb _ ?_ D.branching.2.2.2 t _).imp' (· * card _ * ∏ τ, _) fun C H x
    ψ F e ↦ have k := ofAlgForm_toAlgForm w x ▸
      star_ofAlgForm s; congr(∫ g, $((mul_comm ..).trans (congrArg _ ?_)) ∂$(?_)).trans
      ((H ψ _ 1 _ (Kf ..) x.2.conj.1 k).trans (congr(_ * $(integral_mul_eq_classIntegral w (Kf ..)
    x.2.conj.1 _ k)).trans
    (by simp [restrictToY]; field_simp [Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]; rfl)).symm)⟩

steps.claim: The remaining identifications: F agrees with the coefficient on the embedded group (hypothesis e at reindexed points; the rational coordinate map is an embedding).
steps.lean:
any_goals convert e (.reindex D.lastIndexEquiv (s ▸ rfl) g) <;> [apply (D.spaceY
    _).isEmbedding_ratCoordMatrix.2; apply G.ext_mat]

steps.claim: Simplification of the group-theoretic side conditions (Bessel group of the last grading, block embedding).
steps.lean:
